verdict.rationale: Ramp's core product docs directly describe issuing physical and virtual cards with per-card spend limits/controls (allowed merchants, categories, countries, amount/interval), self-serve creation for teams, and instant virtual cards for SaaS/vendor use cases, matching the founder story closely. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence (e.g. review or case study) confirming the 'minutes' issuance speed or founder-specific onboarding flow beyond vendor docs.
